description: This file defines a static class containing constants used for queue adapters within the Orleans streaming framework. It primarily includes a constant indicating an unlimited message count.

classes.name: QueueAdapterConstants
classes.description: A static class providing constants for queue adapters, notably the unlimited get queue message indicator.

methods.name: UNLIMITED_GET_QUEUE_MSG
methods.description: A constant indicating an unlimited number of messages can be retrieved, used as a return value from GetMaxAddCount.
